git add -A && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
Add checkpoint backend registry and factory

Introduce a backend registry in the checkpoint package: a Factory type, an
OpenEnv construction context, Register/build, and a built-in "git" backend.
Open now builds its primary store through the registry (defaulting to the git
backend) rather than calling NewGitStore directly.

This is the seam Phase 2 needs: a new persistent backend becomes a factory
registered under a type name. Production registers only the git backend;
test-only backends will register through their own RegisterForTesting helpers
so a production binary can never select them. The registry default of git
matches today's Open exactly, so there is no behavior change at default config.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
